eps.o: After 17 years in prison, Max Cady walks free—and back into the lives of the lawyers who jailed him.

eps.t: Why Would I Want to Hurt You?
eps.o: Desperate to understand what's happening with Zack, Anna and Tom take action. Max settles in.
Max asks Anna to represent him in a hearing. Tom invites a coworker over. Natalie makes a friend.
Anna leans on Max to help with a new client. Natalie and Amber get closer. Zack offers an apology.
Max is visited by someone from his past. Anna investigates Nevaeh. Tom's new case gets complicated.
The Bowdens deal with their new neighbor. Natalie begins to question her past. The family takes a trip.
Anna and Tom kick off a dangerous plot against Max. Seeking answers, Natalie hits the road.

eps.t: Los tiempos de Dios son Perfectos
eps.o: As Max hurls accusations, Anna and Tom go on the offensive. Natalie tries to stop Max.
Anna drives to Cape Fear to find Crystal—and answers. Max gives lethal instructions to Nevaeh.
The Bowdens have everything to protect. Max has nothing left to lose.
